item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud gnyan sa lam khyer gyi/ gcod kyi khrid yig bdud bzhi tshar gcod
item.coloph: ces ma rgyad kyi gnyan sa lam khyer gyi gcod khrid bdud bzhi tshar gcod ces pa 'di nyid rang gi dbon skyes blo gros rgya mtsho dang / gling spral tshe dbang g.yung drung a mdo ba ngag phrin bzod pa sogs kyis bskul nas/ shar rdza'i bya bral bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis rang lo don lnga'i thog tu/ shar rdza g.yung drung lhun po'i ri khrod 'og ma dge thang pad ma rgyas pa'i skyed tshal gyi dben khrod du bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun byang chub bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
